title: Sterile Technique
description: Every surface carries something alive. Steam under pressure, at 121 °C, kills it a decade at a time. Unlocks the Autoclave and Sterile Packs: Biology machines catch things, and a pack cleans them.

puzzle.goal: Steam kills nine in ten of what is left every D minutes. Starting from N living spores, write how many are left, L, after a hold of t minutes.
puzzle.name: Decimal reduction
puzzle.ask: Find L for N = @{N}, t = @{t} and D = @{D}.
puzzle.method: Each D minutes divides the count by ten, so t minutes divide it by 10^(t/D).
